Vos équipes IA traitent des données qui: Your AI teams process data belonging to your customers. This page summarizes, in plain language, the agreement governing that processing: who does what, with which data, at which providers, and what remains at the end of the contract.
Résumé du DPA de Lystes AI : rôles RGPD,: Summary of Lystes AI's DPA: GDPR roles, data processed on behalf of the merchant, sub-processors, security, duration and deletion.

Vous êtes responsable de traitement. Vou: You are the data controller. You decide why and how your customers' data is used on your store.
Lystes est votre sous-traitant, au sens: Lystes is your processor, within the meaning of Article 28 of the GDPR. We process this data only on your documented instructions, solely to operate your AI teams. If one of your customers exercises their rights with you (access, rectification, deletion), we assist you in responding.
L'accord couvre tous les traitements néc: The agreement covers all processing necessary for the service to operate on your Shopify or WooCommerce store: product page advice, virtual try-on, skin and hair diagnostics, photo reshoot, review responses, and the other modules you activate. It applies throughout the duration of your subscription and ends with it.
Les données que nous traitons pour votre: The data we process on your behalf

Chaque sous-traitant est lié par un acco: Each sub-processor is bound by an agreement offering guarantees equivalent to those of this DPA. In case of addition or replacement, we inform you in advance and you have a right to object.
Chiffrement en transit (TLS) et au repos: Encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest. Data isolation per merchant account: your data is never mixed with that of another store. Internal access is restricted to what is strictly necessary and logged.
